data.job_title: Graduate Engineer Trainee-Motion Control & Stabilization Research Engineer
data.skills: Motion Control, Stabilization Systems, Gimbal Systems, PID Control, Closed-Loop Control, Control Systems, Feedback Mechanisms, IMU Sensors, Inertial Measurement, Motion Estimation, Encoder Systems, Motor Control, Actuators, Dynamic System Analysis, Real-Time Control, Vibration Analysis, Disturbance Rejection, Multi-Axis Stabilization, Embedded Systems, Robotics, Mechatronics,
data.eligibility_information:
Candidates will be considered only if they do not have any active backlogs in any academic year/semester. Candidates with previous backlogs will be considered only if all backlogs have been successfully cleared and passed.

Only candidates with no active backlogs and completed academic qualifications will be eligible for consideration.
data.additional_information:
Work on research and development of stabilization systems, motion control architectures, gimbal systems, and inertial compensation mechanisms for aerial platforms and payloads.
 DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES 
Research stabilization techniques for airborne payload and gimbal systems. 
Study PID control systems and closed-loop motion control architectures. 
Analyze vibration effects and disturbance rejection mechanisms in aerial systems. 
Investigate IMU behavior, sensor feedback, and motion estimation techniques. 
Study encoder-based positioning and motor feedback systems for stabilization. 
Analyze control loop latency and real-time response requirements. 
Support testing and tuning of stabilization and gimbal subsystems. 
Evaluate multi-axis stabilization architectures and motion control strategies. 
Benchmark commercial stabilization systems and control methodologies. 
Prepare technical documentation related to motion control and stabilization systems. 

Skills Required 

Strong understanding of control systems and feedback mechanisms. 
Familiarity with sensors, IMUs, and inertial measurement principles. 
Understanding of motors, actuators, and motion control fundamentals. 
Ability to analyze dynamic system response and stability behavior. 
Understanding of basic embedded systems and real-time control concepts. 

PREFERRED SKILLS 
Exposure to robotics or mechatronics-based projects. 
Familiarity with MATLAB or simulation-based control analysis.
Understanding of PID tuning and control loop optimization.

Education Qualification-M.Tech/M.E/PhD
Experience Required-0-2Yrs
data.additional_details:
Please find below the additional important details regarding our Company Clauses & Policies:

1.NDA – Non-Disclosure Agreement
Candidates must not disclose or share any confidential information related to their job role, projects, company operations, or work responsibilities with any external party. This clause will remain applicable for a lifetime.
2.NCC – Non-Compete Clause
Upon joining the company, when you decide to leave the organization in the future, you will not be eligible to join any direct competitor of the company for a period of 3 years post the last working day.
3.Minimum Service Agreement – 2 Years
Candidates from any branch having less than 2 Years of Experience are required to sign a mandatory 2-year Minimum Service Agreement. However, Candidates with more than 2 years of prior experience are exempted from the Minimum Service Agreement. Additionally breach of this agreement will result in a financial penalty of 40% of the CTC.
